inputIdentityScope: Actual live fixture recorded references retained at finish and hashed after the suite. Imported-file input references were not observed.
limitations: Delayed references are not immutable snapshots at analyzer entry and provide no before/after input hash proof.
The finish payload omits raw internal fits and unrounded lag/clock fields; rounded latency/clock measurements remain available. No missing field is inferred or reconstructed here.
Full left/right buffers intentionally differ during crosstalk segments; equality is not required.
Retaining references extends object/buffer lifetimes during later analyses and may affect allocation or timing; this observer effect does not establish a failure cause.
Test-harness instrumentation changes execution context; this observation is not a production repair or qualification pass.

findings.title: Left and right levels differ
findings.meaning: A channel imbalance above 0.5 dB shifts the stereo image.
findings.action: Check the balance setting and the output pots or faders; compare cables.

findings.title: Frequency response is not flat
findings.meaning: The level changes by more than 1 dB between 100 Hz and 10 kHz, so the output is audibly tilted or filtered.
findings.action: Check EQ, filter and isolator positions are neutral, then retest.

findings.title: Polarity is inverted
findings.meaning: A channel is out of phase with the digital signal; mixed with a correct channel, bass cancels.
findings.action: Check for a miswired cable or output; correct the wiring.
